heading_en: Transitional Measures for Risk Retention by Ultimate Designated Parent Companies
summary_ja: 適用日に保有する証券化エクスポージャーについて、保有を継続する場合に限り、新告示第226条第3項を適用しない。
summary_en: Provides that Article 226, paragraph (3) of the new notice does not apply to securitization exposures held on the Application Date, only while the holding continues.
paragraphs: With respect to the risk weight of securitization exposures held by an Ultimate Designated Parent Company on the Application Date, only where that Ultimate Designated Parent Company continues to hold them, the provisions of Article 226, paragraph (3) of the New Ultimate Designated Parent Company Notice do not apply.
